project_type: Personal portfolio - GitHub Pages static site, being rebuilt with React + Vite + Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
build_system: Vite with GitHub Pages deployment (output to root via docs/ or custom build config)
test_framework: Vite build validation (no unit tests needed for a portfolio site)
test_command: npm run build && npx serve dist -l 3000 --no-clipboard
verification_instructions: 1. Run npm run build to ensure no build errors. 2. Check that dist/ directory contains index.html and assets. 3. Verify photo.png is included in the build output.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ directory is generated by Vite build. Not checked into git. GitHub Pages will serve from the root (index.html at root level after build).
setup_instructions: 1. cd /projects/sandbox/AARYANSHARMA19.github.io 2. npm install 3. npm run dev (for development) 4. npm run build (for production)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET - can install any npm packages. Node.js 22 available. Output must be static files deployable to GitHub Pages.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md exists. The final build output must produce an index.html at root or configure GitHub Pages to serve from a specific directory.
key_patterns: Current site: single index.html with inline CSS/JS, dark theme (#0f0f0f bg, #00ff88 accent), Space Grotesk font, IntersectionObserver scroll reveals. New site: React components, Tailwind utilities, Framer Motion for animations, modular file structure.
relevant_files: index.html (current - will be replaced by build output)
photo.png (profile photo - must be preserved and used in Hero/About)
README.md (will be rewritten with setup/run/build docs)
directory_structure: Root: GitHub Pages files + Vite project. src/: React components organized by section. public/: static assets (photo.png, resume PDF). dist/: build output (not committed). The final deployment strategy: Vite builds to dist/, and we configure the project so GitHub Pages serves from root by copying build output or using a GitHub Action.
